command:
ADB="$HOME/Library/Android/sdk/platform-tools/adb"; SERIALS=$("$ADB" devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}'); COUNT=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d' | wc -l | tr -d ' '); test "$COUNT" = "1"; SERIAL=$(printf '%s
' "$SERIALS" | sed '/^$/d'); "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -n link.localclimate.app/.MainActivity >/dev/null; sleep 1; PID=$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof link.localclimate.app | tr -d ''); test -n "$PID"; printf 'PID=%s
' "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell cat /proc/net/unix | grep -E 'webview_devtools_remote|chrome_devtools_remote' || true
